title: Cross-Spoke Idea Routing: ideas captured in one spoke must be routed to their target spoke at closeo
acceptance_criteria: Closeout detects lugs/ideas with target_spoke field pointing to a different spoke
Cross-spoke items are written to lugs/outgoing/ with target spoke metadata
Hub distribution picks up outgoing/ items and routes to correct spoke incoming/
No manual spoke-to-spoke file copying required
